description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kubernetes EndpointSlices, including creation, conversion, deletion handling, and label management, specific to the endpointslicemirroring controller.

classes.name: addrTypePortMapKey
classes.description: Type used to uniquely identify groups of endpoint ports and address types.

methods.name: newAddrTypePortMapKey
methods.description: Generates a key from endpoint ports and address type.

methods.name: addressType
methods.description: Determines the address type (IPv4 or IPv6) from the key.

methods.name: newEndpointSlice
methods.description: Creates a new EndpointSlice object from given Endpoints, ports, address type, and optional slice name.

methods.name: getEndpointSlicePrefix
methods.description: Returns a prefix for EndpointSlice name based on service name.

methods.name: addressToEndpoint
methods.description: Converts an EndpointAddress to a discovery.Endpoint and determines its address type.

methods.name: epPortsToEpsPorts
methods.description: Converts EndpointPort list from Endpoints to EndpointSlice format.

methods.name: getServiceFromDeleteAction
methods.description: Extracts a Service object from a delete action, handling tombstones.

methods.name: getEndpointsFromDeleteAction
methods.description: Extracts an Endpoints object from a delete action, handling tombstones.

methods.name: getEndpointSliceFromDeleteAction
methods.description: Extracts an EndpointSlice object from a delete action, handling tombstones.

methods.name: endpointsControllerKey
methods.description: Generates a controller key string for an EndpointSlice.

methods.name: skipMirror
methods.description: Checks if the skip mirror label is set to true.

methods.name: hasLeaderElection
methods.description: Checks if leader election annotation is present.

methods.name: cloneAndRemoveKeys
methods.description: Clones a map and removes specified keys.

methods.name: managedByChanged
methods.description: Determines if the managed-by label has changed between two EndpointSlices.

methods.name: managedByController
methods.description: Checks if an EndpointSlice is managed by the controller.
